title: Upper biased Anterior Posterior Bro day
author: Matthew
desc: Unlock your upper body potential with the Upper Biased HML Program, a focused 12-week journey designed for serious lifters. Committing just 5 days a week, you'll engage in a blend of hypertrophy, muscle, and strength training, ensuring balanced development and peak performance. Each session is meticulously crafted to challenge your limits and promote growth, making it the perfect choice for those ready to elevate their upper body game. Get ready to build strength and sculpt your physique like never before!

Primary strength anchor. Each set its own weight and its own progression.
Tricep-biased. No flies in the program, so this carries more of the chest load.
